name: Short-squeeze ignition: deep-negative funding gate + momentum turning UP (NOT momentum-alone)
rationale: Thesis: a short squeeze ignites when price starts turning UP while shorts are still crowded — the rally forces covering, which feeds the rally. We want the FIRST flicker of upward momentum FROM a crowded-short base, not generic trend. Entry (long-only spot): funding_rate < deeply-negative floor [-0.005,-0.0006] (positioning gate, crowded shorts) AND ret_Nd over a short lookback > a small positive floor (the ignition trigger). DISCONFIRMER: must beat short-lookback ret_Nd>floor ALONE with the SAME lookback and floor and no funding gate — if lone momentum matches net Sharpe, the funding gate is decorative and this is trend-following. The funding gate is the actual claim: it must pick out the squeeze-fuelled subset of up-moves. funding_feature null — positioning level, not carry. Exit on momentum stalling or funding normalizing up.
catalyst: upward short-horizon momentum igniting while funding is still deeply negative (crowded shorts)
